result.question: Quantos hospitais registraram internações mas nunca tiveram nenhum óbito registrado?
result.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS hospitais_sem_obito FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i."CNES" FROM internacoes i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM internacoes d WHERE d."CNES" = i."CNES" AND d."MORTE" = true)) sub;
result.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h."CNES") AS total_hospitais FROM hospital h JOIN internacoes i ON h."CNES" = i."CNES" WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM internacoes d WHERE d."CNES" = i."CNES" AND d."MORTE" = true );
